steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each stop is placed by its reason code and whether the code is on the list.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Stop with no reason code
findings.fix: Code the stop with its cause

findings.title: Reason not in the code list
findings.fix: Map the reason to the list

findings.title: Duration does not match start and end

outcome.notChecked: Causes that need a physical check.

example:

pros: Checks a stop with no reason code, a reason not in the code list, and a stop with a duration that does not match its start and end.
cons: Not checked: Causes that need a physical check.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-downtime-log skill on the records for this review.
